build.buildCommand: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w @sadel/shared && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w @sadel/backend

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 20260714000000_add_hardware_store_business_type --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma; npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && node packages/backend/dist/index.js
